task_completion.description: Wireshark is open and the 'eth0' interface is selected for capture.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Wireshark main window showing 'eth0' highlighted in the interface list or selected in the Capture Options dialog.

task_completion.description: A capture filter for 'icmp' is applied before starting the capture.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Capture Filter' input box (often green) containing the text 'icmp' or 'proto icmp' in the Capture Options or main start screen.

task_completion.description: The agent runs the ping command in a terminal to generate traffic.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal window showing the command 'ping -c 10 8.8.8.8' being executed.

task_completion.description: Wireshark shows a live capture containing only ICMP packets.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Wireshark packet list pane showing 'ICMP' in the Protocol column, with no other protocols (like TCP, HTTP, or DNS) visible during the capture.

task_completion.description: The capture is saved to the specific file path required.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' or 'Export Specified Packets' dialog showing the path '/home/ga/Documents/captures/icmp_strict.pcapng' and the file format as pcapng.

integrity.description: The agent used the Wireshark GUI to configure filters and save the file rather than just using CLI tools like tshark.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing mouse cursor movement, menu clicks, and dialog interactions within the Wireshark graphical interface.

integrity.description: The packets in Wireshark correspond to the terminal ping activity.
integrity.visual_evidence: The timestamps and sequence of ICMP packets in Wireshark appearing after the terminal command is initiated.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply use a display filter to hide noise, but used a capture filter to prevent noise from being recorded.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Capture Filter' field in the Capture Options being populated, rather than just the 'Display Filter' bar at the top of the packet list.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use the 'eth0' interface. The capture filter must be set to 'icmp' (Capture Filter is different from Display Filter). The final file must be saved at '/home/ga/Documents/captures/icmp_strict.pcapng'. The capture must contain at least 10 ICMP packets (ping -c 10 generates 20 packets: 10 requests and 10 replies) and exactly 0 non-ICMP packets. Background noise (HTTP/TCP) is active during the task, so a capture filter is mandatory to achieve zero noise packets.
